title: Pernod Ricard Restructures Distribution to Triple US RTD Footprint - Brewbound
summary: Pernod Ricard Restructures Distribution to Triple US RTD Footprint Brewbound
ai_summary: Pernod Ricard Restructures Distribution to Triple US RTD Footprint Brewbound — The article details Pernod Ricard’s restructuring of its distribution network to triple its ready-to-drink footprint in the United States, as reported by Brewbound. It explains the changes and their expected effects on market reach.
